assumptions.text: Solid product ('solar_array' family): moulded-shell checks (draft, undercut, wall thickness, clamp tonnage) do not apply; the measured checks are process fit, stock size and thinnest section on the product CAD
assumptions.label: estimate

issues.description: The BOM specifies 10 modules, but the CAD layout contains 14. Rail, clamp, attachment and electrical quantities cannot be released against conflicting array sizes.
issues.fix: Choose the intended layout, then reconcile the module count and recalculate all mounting and electrical quantities.
issues.rule_citation: BOM quantities must match the released assembly drawing — standard manufacturing BOM control practice.

issues.description: Rail alignment, module gaps and roof-edge margin lack a common datum and an installation inspection method. The specified gaps may conflict with the selected module's clamp zones.
issues.fix: Issue a dimensioned roof layout with datums, measurement points, rail spans and the selected module's permitted clamp zones.
issues.rule_citation: Module mounting must follow the manufacturer's installation instructions — IEC 61730-1 (PV module construction requirements).

issues.description: Module, inverter, isolator and cable ratings are approximate or unspecified; string voltage, current and connector compatibility cannot be checked.
issues.fix: Select exact manufacturer part numbers and issue a string diagram with temperature-corrected voltage, current, cable, isolator and connector checks.
issues.rule_citation: PV array electrical design must account for component ratings and string configuration — IEC 62548-1 (PV array design requirements).

issues.description: The battery pack and battery inverter/charger have no defined electrical interface or operating architecture with the grid-tie inverter.
issues.fix: Specify an approved AC- or DC-coupled architecture, compatible equipment models, protection scheme and commissioning tests.
issues.rule_citation: Power conversion equipment safety and installation interfaces require verification — IEC 62109-1 (PV power-converter safety).

issues.description: The stationary battery has no specified installation location, enclosure, thermal clearance or ventilation provisions.
issues.fix: Specify a certified battery system and its installation location; document required clearances, ventilation, protection and compliance with the battery manufacturer's instructions.
issues.rule_citation: Safety requirements for industrial lithium batteries — IEC 62619.

issues.description: Solid product (424.3 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: on-site installation of bought-in modules, rails and inverter.
issues.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
issues.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)

issues.description: 14 modules on the layout (projected module area ≈ 21.4 m²): standard 1722 × 1134 mm class, bought in.
issues.fix: Keep the 45 cm roof-edge margin; check rafter spacing against the roof-hook pitch on site.
issues.rule_citation: Installer practice: edge margins for wind uplift zones (EN 1991-1-4) — Estimate

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Modules counted in the layout CAD, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.fix: Survey the roof (area, orientation, shading) before ordering.
issues.rule_citation: Site survey before PV design — installer practice

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Array footprint, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Anodised aluminium rails and stainless-steel fasteners are specified without an isolation or corrosion-control detail for exposed rooftop joints.
issues.fix: Define compatible fastener grades, isolating washers where needed and a documented corrosion-protection detail for the coastal installation.
issues.rule_citation: Atmospheric corrosivity classification guides material and coating selection — ISO 9223.
